decision: Use the user-confirmed purchased Arducam B0477 catalog configuration as the fixed overhead eye-to-hand Phase 1 primary vision source on an independent commercial floor tripod identified by Amazon ASIN B0CSYB4YQ2. The selected listing identifies only a candidate support: delivered identity, interface, payload, working height, rigidity, repeatability, sag, drift, vibration, tethering, floor stability, collision clearance, calibration, and every motion/contact gate remain unverified. Retain an arm-mounted camera only as an unselected Phase 2 local-refinement option.

authority.note: This plan records the approved architectural direction but does not mutate or release Freeze 009. A new controlled freeze must promote it atomically.

prohibited_roles: automatic fallback for a failed primary camera
override of a disagreeing primary observation

frame_contract.controller_bridge: R_ctrl_T_Wv remains separately measured and bounded
frame_contract.rule: Board tags alone do not establish robot pose. Without a commissioned Wv_T_C_overhead_optical, an overhead observation is board-relative diagnostic evidence only; independent B_T_Wv evidence may seed that extrinsic only when bound to a simultaneous camera observation.

runtime_sequence: verify exact camera identity, mode, settings, calibration hashes, and static-support witness
move only to a prequalified clear observation posture
wait for measured arm and support settling
flush bounded buffered frames and capture a uniquely fresh frame
require all six tags, solve board pose from T0-T3, and validate K0/P0 independently
validate device presence, seating, orientation, and target map
bind the accepted observation and calibration hashes to the pending action occurrence
optionally observe a top-visible tool marker and correct only above the proven clearance plane
execute the short qualified approach and contact without assuming the target remains visible
retract to a clear observation posture
reacquire vision and verify the outcome through the independent computer or Android observer

visibility_contract.commissioning: All six installed tags must be visible and accepted throughout the complete commissioned overview dataset.
visibility_contract.startup: With the arm in the primary clear observation posture, require all six tags; T0-T3 form the pose solve and K0/P0 remain independent checks.
visibility_contract.per_action: Capture all six tags from a prequalified primary or recovery observation posture before descent. Missing, ambiguous, stale, or weakly distributed tags block descent.
visibility_contract.occlusion_strategy: Observe while retracted, approach and contact, retract, then observe and verify.
visibility_contract.recovery: Only a prequalified retreat to a second clear observation posture is allowed; there is no blind continuation or automatic secondary-camera substitution.

optical_screening.coverage_margin_note: The screening envelope adds 30 mm around every board edge. It is not a released tolerance.
optical_screening.field_of_view_rule: Choose support height from collision clearance first, then compute H/V lens coverage at the exact native crop. Never select from diagonal FOV alone.
optical_screening.candidate_camera_body: The Arducam B0477/IMX283 catalog configuration with included nominal 16 mm manual-focus C-mount lens and metal case is purchased and pending receipt inspection; Arducam B0459-1 remains an unselected research alternate.
optical_screening.previous_wide_lens: The LN069 100-degree lens is not selected for the static architecture because it may waste resolution at the final safe gantry height.

calibration_dependencies: physical camera identity, full native 3:2 mode, pixel format, driver, crop, and locked settings
camera intrinsics and distortion at the exact lens, focus, aperture, resolution, and crop
measured six-tag corner and optical-plane map in B
static Wv_T_C_overhead_optical solved directly or derived from independently measured Wv_T_B plus simultaneous B_T_C_overhead_optical
robot reference and independently bounded R_ctrl-to-Wv correlation
keyboard pose, key polygons, key surface heights, and safe insets
phone pose, screen plane, orientation, UI profile, homography, and safe insets
route-specific G_T_T tool TCP, compliance, travel, and contact limits
held-out end-to-end keyboard and phone validation
acceptance_gates_to_define_and_measure: persistent camera identity and exact mode survive close, reopen, and reboot without silent crop or rescale
intrinsic calibration uses at least 20 accepted varied ChArUco views and retains held-out residual evidence
complete calibrated coverage contains all six tag tiles with border margin at both observation postures
all-six-tag startup and route observation trials pass under the complete qualified lighting envelope
T0-T3 pose and K0/P0 held-out checks pass independently
multi-frame pose stability, latency, freshness, and settle-time limits are measured
tripod, camera, tether, cable, and lighting hardware remain outside every approved swept volume
warm-up, arm cycling, cable disturbance, remove/reinstall, and 24-hour drift tests pass the allocated vision budget
every keyboard and phone route has a qualified primary and recovery observation
camera loss, stale replay, settings drift, tag loss/outlier, support movement, and board movement fault injections produce zero descent or contact permits

intrinsics: camera, sensor, lens, focus, aperture, resolution, pixel format, ROI, crop, driver, or image orientation change
static_extrinsic_and_visibility: tripod, head, center column, camera plate, fastener, camera, tether, cable strain, floor contact, or optical-axis disturbance
collision or impact involving the tripod or camera
unexpected reference-witness, pose, or residual drift
tag_map: tag movement, damage, replacement, laminate change, or board warp
robot_registration: arm clamp, base, reference procedure, servo, firmware, or controller-frame change
device_maps: device removal or reseat, case/protector, station, orientation, layout, OS, or UI change
tool_tcp: tool, tip, spring, cartridge, gripper seating, or compliance change
